access.notes: The agent should adopt typical values from literature: ion mass M, stiffness coefficients c1, c2, quartic coefficient b ~ 4e8 erg/cm^4, transition temperature Tc, and soft mode frequency in the paraelectric phase Ω0 ~ 10^12 s^{-1} to extract α. The paper cites V.G. Vaks 'Introduction to the Microscopic Theory of Ferroelectrics' (1973). Values are chosen to be representative of BaTiO3; exact numbers are not uniquely fixed but must produce a gap in the 1e10–1e11 s^{-1} range.
